style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, full-bleed lavender #A98CC0 and deep navy #16294F flat fields for the comparison, pain-point, equivalence and trust screens, puffed cloud-white #EDEAE6 pillow-top relief field for the lifestyle screen
style.direction: premium cushioned household-paper commerce with flat navy and lavender infographic panels
style.iconSystem: single-family thin-line outline glyphs in one uniform stroke weight, drawn in clean white #FFFFFF on flat lavender #A98CC0 discs, no fill, no gradient, no shading
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral high-key studio light with a broad front-left key, large bounce fill and soft contact shadows only, no hard speculars; macro lifted by a soft key sweeping from the upper left; flat panels lit evenly with no falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium cushioned household-paper ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, lavender #A98CC0, deep navy #16294F and puffed cloud white #EDEAE6; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a broad front-left key, large bounce fill and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with one heavy display headline band; single-family thin-line outline icon style on flat lavender discs; clean high-end paper texture photography mixed with minimal flat infographic panels; stable slight 3/4 pack angle and roll scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numerals.
noDrift: no invented numerals, units, ratio marks or badge artwork
no brand wordmark or certification seal anywhere
style.presentationRules: carry pack always upright with roll tops forming one level row; a sheet sample always stretched flat toward the lens with the fold crease visible; both panels of any split screen share identical angle, crop, scale and light; the same sheet and embossing render in every roll size
style.surfaceSystem: puffed cloud-white #EDEAE6 pillow-top relief as the paper-surface language, matte flat colour fields everywhere else, brushed metal bracket hardware in the size screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one heavy display headline band plus one light sub-line, words only ever composited later into reserved blank bands, plates and discs
